# Bundled font licenses

This directory contains six Latin and Latin Extended WOFF2 assets for the font families
used in OpenTogetherTube's [visual overhaul #2031](https://github.com/dyc3/opentogethertube/pull/2031),
selectively ported from commit
[`4ea9029`](https://github.com/dyc3/opentogethertube/commit/4ea9029429a98561ba7c213c54c55ef0f0c56800).

These fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, separately from the
application's AGPL license. The complete notices below are reproduced without changes
from the [Google Fonts repository](https://github.com/google/fonts).

| Font family    | Assets                   | Bundled license                                          | Official license source                                                                            |
| -------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Bebas Neue     | `bebas-neue-*.woff2`     | [LICENSE-Bebas-Neue.txt](LICENSE-Bebas-Neue.txt)         | [google/fonts: bebasneue](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/bebasneue/OFL.txt)         |
| Hanken Grotesk | `hanken-grotesk-*.woff2` | [LICENSE-Hanken-Grotesk.txt](LICENSE-Hanken-Grotesk.txt) | [google/fonts: hankengrotesk](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/hankengrotesk/OFL.txt) |
| Space Mono     | `space-mono-*.woff2`     | [LICENSE-Space-Mono.txt](LICENSE-Space-Mono.txt)         | [google/fonts: spacemono](https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/spacemono/OFL.txt)         |
